_about: Thomas Smyth (1808-1873), Old School Presbyterian minister of Second Presbyterian Church, Charleston: Complete Works, edited by J. Wm. Flinn (Columbia, S.C.: R. L. Bryan, 1908-1912, 10 vols), a reissue of his writings on church polity, the Westminster Assembly, apostolic succession, the unity of the human races and much else, paid for by a fund he left. Princeton copies, except vol. VI (Toronto). Volume numbers read off each title page. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.
